relics.description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Manaburn it has to a random enemy and then trigger it.

relics.name: Paper Crow
relics.description: Enemies take 25% additional damage from Manaburn.
relics.flavorText: Arbiter of doubt and curses folded one thousand times...

relics.name: Ripped Doll
relics.description: At the start of the first 2 turns of combat, Conjure.
relics.flavorText: The last reminder of your prior self. It still holds latent magicks.

relics.name: Shredded Doll
relics.description:
At the start of your turn, Conjure.
Start combat with 1 Ritual.
relics.flavorText: A reminder of your weakness, and yet you still can't let go.

relics.name: Tome of Portalmancy
relics.description: Whenever you create a Void, apply 2 Manaburn to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: A grimoire detailing the construction and maintenance of interplanar gates.

relics.name: Zener Deck
relics.description: Start each combat with ESP in your Spellbook.
relics.flavorText: “One, two, three, all eyes should be on me.”

relics.name: Zetsumei
relics.description: Every time you play 4 Spells in a combat, gain a Ceremony.
relics.flavorText: A blade favored by mages due to its ability to channel casted magic back into itself.

relics.name: Amulet of Unyielding
relics.description: Whenever you spend Vigor, gain 1 Strength for every 12 Vigor spent.
relics.flavorText: Strength once thought fleeting flows through you as if it had always been there.

relics.name: Berserker's Guide
relics.description: At the start of your turn, gain 3 Vigor.
relics.flavorText: The text is illegible.

relics.name: Champion's Crown
relics.description: Start each combat in a random Stance, and then trigger that Stance's Skill Bonus twice.
relics.flavorText: A WINNER IS YOU!

relics.name: Defensive Thesis
relics.description: Defensive Stance's Finisher Bonus grants 3 more Block.
relics.flavorText: Pro tip: Don't get hit.

relics.name: Dolphin's Style Guide
relics.description: If you end your turn while in no Stance, draw 1 additional card next turn.
relics.flavorText: Author: Renowned explorer and pugilist Dolphin K. Mist.

relics.name: Power Armor
relics.description: Start each combat with 2 Strength. Your maximum Vigor and Counter is 10.
relics.flavorText: Bought used.

relics.name: Signature Finisher
relics.description: Upon pickup, Enchant a Finisher with Signature.
relics.flavorText: And now, it's time for my ULTIMATE MOVE!

relics.name: Spectre's Hand
relics.description:
Whenever you enter a Stance, gain an Echo of a Basic Strike or Defend.
It's free to play this turn.
relics.flavorText: Some victories stay with you.

relics.name: Victorious Crown
relics.description:
Start each combat in a random Stance, and then trigger that Stance's Skill Bonus twice.
The first time you play a Finisher each turn, draw 2 cards and enter a random Stance.
relics.flavorText: Conglaturation!! You are the greatest winner.

relics.name: Baalor's Lordly Plate
relics.description: Whenever you Brace, Brace 1 more.
relics.flavorText: One can never have enough armor.

relics.name: Bottled Black Hole
relics.description: On pickup, Enchant a card with Temporal.
relics.flavorText: Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.

relics.name: Bronze Gear
relics.description:
At the start of each combat, add Gear Up into your Hand.
Guardian starts the run with a random common Gem.
relics.flavorText: Protection where you need it most.

relics.name: Cryo Chamber
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Stasis slot. Whenever a card enters Stasis, Upgrade it for the remainder of combat.
relics.flavorText: Things always seem better coming out than they did going in.

relics.name: Guardian Gear
relics.description:
At the start of each combat, add Gear Up into your Hand.
Whenever you enter Defensive Mode, gain [E] and draw 2 cards.
relics.flavorText: Replace every 3,000 floors.

relics.name: Pick of Rhapsody
relics.description: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, add a random Gem to the rewards.
relics.flavorText: With as many gemstones that litter the Spire, it is hard to imagine anyone so unlucky to have needed this Pick to aid them.

relics.name: Pilot's Codex
relics.description: At the start of each combat, put 2 random cards in Stasis.
relics.flavorText: Designs and diagrams of the Spire's earliest manually-driven prototypes, by Master Pilot David.

relics.name: Quantum Chamber
relics.description: The first time you put a card into Stasis each turn, Accelerate it.
relics.flavorText: You get the chicken by hatching the egg, not by smashing it.

relics.name: Sack of Gems
relics.description: Upon pickup, you may choose up to 5 random Gems to add to your Deck.
relics.flavorText: Ooh... shiny!

relics.name: Wander Bots
relics.description: At the start of each combat, lose 1 Stasis slot. Gain [E] at the start of your turn.
relics.flavorText: These drones find the most wonderful salvage, but require processing power to maintain.

relics.name: Black Powder
relics.description: Whenever you trigger a Dead On effect, deal 2 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: Handle with care.

relics.name: Charred Glove
relics.description: Whenever you draw or create a Curse, gain 3 Vigor.
relics.flavorText: Parts of the glove still glow with otherworldly cinders.

relics.name: Clasped Locket
relics.description:
The first time you draw a Curse each turn, Exhaust it and draw 2 cards.
Upon pickup, obtain 2 Injuries.
relics.flavorText: It won't open anymore.

relics.name: Old Locket
relics.description: At the start of each combat, add a Memento into your Hand.
relics.flavorText: There's a faded picture inside.

relics.name: Red Scarf
relics.description: Whenever you apply a new debuff to an enemy, gain 3 Block.
relics.flavorText: It's warm and fuzzy.

relics.name: Rye Stalk
relics.description: At the start of turn 4, gain 1 Rugged.
relics.flavorText: Still in mint condition, despite being chewed on for so long.

relics.name: Shotglass
relics.description: The first time you use a potion each combat, procure a random potion. You can only use 1 potion each combat.
relics.flavorText: Any liquid placed inside changes into something else.

relics.name: Spyglass
relics.description: Concentration remains across turns.
relics.flavorText: Property of Kestin Highfin.

relics.name: Straight Razor
relics.description: Whenever you remove or Transform a card from your Deck, heal 15 HP.
relics.flavorText: For a cleaner shave...

relics.name: Jar of Tobsco
relics.description: Start each combat with 1 Intensity.
relics.flavorText: A little extra heat makes everything better.

relics.name: Libra
relics.description: Your Strikes and Defends count towards the progression of Crushing and Searing Ghostflames.
relics.flavorText: Balance in all things.

relics.name: Mark of the Ether
relics.description: Whenever you Ignite a Ghostflame, gain 4 Block.
relics.flavorText: Let's see if we can do... better.

relics.name: Olexa's Shield
relics.description: Powers are counted towards the progression of Searing and Crushing Ghostflames.
relics.flavorText: Protection on-demand.

relics.name: Recycler
relics.description: The first time a non-Status, non-Curse Ethereal card is Exhausted each combat, add a copy to your Hand.
relics.flavorText: One day, it shall be recycled too.

relics.name: Red Candle
relics.description: Whenever you apply Soulburn, apply 2 additional Soulburn.
relics.flavorText: Fire BURNS...

relics.name: Sneaky Teakwood Match
relics.description: The first time you Ignite a Ghostflame each turn, you may choose to Advance or Retract.
relics.flavorText: Lights on any surface!

relics.name: Thermal Stone
relics.description: Whenever you Exhaust 4 cards, Ignite the current Ghostflame.
relics.flavorText: A spark would liven this thing up!

relics.name: Spirit Brand
relics.description: The first time you Ignite a Ghostflame each turn, gain 3 Block.
relics.flavorText: A bound protector.

relics.name: Black Heart of Goo
relics.description: Whenever you Consume, heal 3 HP, up to 15 each combat.
relics.flavorText: The Secret of the Ooze.

relics.name: Goop Dweller
relics.description: At the start of each combat, Split into a Bruiser Slime.
relics.flavorText: He followed me home. Can I keep it?

relics.name: Heart of Goo
relics.description: Whenever you Consume, heal 2 HP, up to 8 each combat.
relics.flavorText: I feel so funky.

relics.name: Jeremiah's Banner
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Slime slot and Split into a random Slime.
relics.flavorText: You and ooze army.

relics.name: Protective Gear
relics.description: Reduce the damage you take from Tackles by 3.
relics.flavorText: The best defense is a good offense.

relics.name: Slimed Tail
relics.description: Whenever you Split, gain 3 Block.
relics.flavorText: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat, completely covered in slime.

relics.name: Slimy Skull
relics.description: Whenever you apply Goop, apply an additional 1 Goop.
relics.flavorText: A Snecko skull in absolutely awful condition. Unclean and slimy, dirt and grime stick to it like glue.

relics.name: Stone of Nomakk
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Potency.
relics.flavorText: When presented to one of your Goop Gang, it seems to make the blob dance.

relics.name: Tarr Blob
relics.description:
At the start of each combat, lose 1 Slime slot.
At the start of your turn, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: The bad kind of Slime.

relics.name: Loaded Die
relics.description: Whenever a card is Muddled, gain 1 Block.
relics.flavorText: Cheese-stuffed.

relics.name: Rare Booster Box
relics.description: Upon pickup, obtain an Offclass Rare card.
relics.flavorText: Mint condition.

relics.name: Ring of the Snek
relics.description: Whenever you activate 3 Overflow effects, apply 1 Weak and 1 Vulnerable to a random enemy.
relics.flavorText: Illegible, unreadable, due by Thursday.

relics.name: Seal of Approval
relics.description: Upon pickup, choose 1 of 5 Uncommon Offclass Powers to add to your Deck.
relics.flavorText: I'm The Ironclad and this is my favorite Relic in the Spire. -Merchant Advertising Pamphlet

relics.name: Sleeved Ace
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain a Marked Card+.
relics.flavorText: We're all aces.

relics.name: Snake-Charmer's Flute
relics.description: Muddled cards can't cost 3.
relics.flavorText: Sssssss...

relics.name: Snecko Soul
relics.description: At the start of each combat, add Soul Roll to your Hand.

relics.name: Super Snecko Soul
relics.description:
At the start of each combat, add Soul Roll to your Hand.
At the start of your turn, draw a card and Muddle it.

relics.name: Unidentified Egg
relics.description:
Whenever you add an Offclass card to your Deck, Upgrade it.
Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Offclass cards.
relics.flavorText: What will hatch? Pay $1000 to see.

potions.name: Alchyrical Elixir
potions.description: The next Function you create is free to play.

potions.name: Kio's Clever Concoction
potions.description: Choose 1 of 3 random cards to Encode, repeat until you create a Function.

potions.name: Vexing Draught
potions.description:
Gain 2 Strength.
Gain 2 Dexterity.
Stash 2 Burns.

potions.name: Bottled Technique
potions.description: Trigger your current Stance's Skill Bonus 5 times.

potions.name: Liquid Accelerant
potions.description: Accelerate until a card exits Stasis.

potions.name: Quantum Elixir
potions.description:
Choose 1 of 3 cards to place into Stasis.
Repeat until your Stasis slots are full.

potions.name: Liquid Void
potions.description:
Put a card from your Exhaust Pile into your Hand.
It's free to play this turn.

potions.name: Ecto Cooler
potions.description:
Choose 1 of 3 Afterlife cards to add to your Hand.
It's free to play this turn.

potions.name: Inferno Potion
potions.description: Ghostflames apply Soulburn and deal damage to ALL enemies this combat.

enchantments.name: Temporal
enchantments.description: The card starts combat in Stasis.

enchantments.name: Crowned
enchantments.description: This card is free to play.

enchantments.name: Signature
enchantments.description: Free to play, requires no Stance to be played, does not exit Stance upon use.

enchantments.name: Hardcoded
enchantments.description: At the start of combat, Encode this.

Normal Enemy: 15 gold.

Boss: 100 gold.

Whenever you play a Skill while in a Stance, trigger that Stance's bonus effect, up to 3 times.
Skill Bonuses triggered by card effects do not count towards this limit.

If you play 7 Power cards in the combat, Awaken.

keywords.name: Brace

keywords.description: An effect that triggers when this card is merged into a Function.

Stance.
While in Defensive Mode you have 3 Thorns and your Block does not expire.

Any effect that caused you to lose {Energy:energyIcons()}, even if you had none to lose.
(Does not include {Energy:energyIcons()} spent playing cards.)

Place this card into your Sequence.

Status, Colorless, and Curse cards, or cards from other characters.

keywords.description: At the start of your turn, add a Soul Roll to another player's Hand.

keywords.name: Exotic Form
keywords.description: At the end of your turn, gain Strength for each unique color played.

keywords.name: Forked Tongue
keywords.description: The first time each turn you play a card that costs [E][E][E] or more, play it twice.

keywords.description: Whenever you Overflow, apply Venom to a random enemy.

keywords.name: Gamble
keywords.description: Next turn, draw cards and Muddle them.

keywords.description: Decrease a Power for some time.

keywords.description: The next time you attack this enemy, your Goop wil not be removed.

keywords.description: The first card each turn that targets enemies is played twice.

keywords.name: Flame Tackle
keywords.description: "Tackle" cards deal additional damage to enemies.

keywords.description: The first time you Consume each turn, gain a Lick.

keywords.name: Goop Armor
keywords.description: Gain Block whenever you Consume.

keywords.description: The first card you play each turn that targets enemies also Commands.

keywords.description: "Tackle" cards deal additional damage to you.

keywords.name: Recycling
keywords.description: At the start of your turn, Slurp.
